PD-A1.what: TASK-20260824-f094e8 DECLARED coordination/goals/GOAL-DIFFP-84d641/batches/BATCH-145531/dispatch_queue.json AS ONE OF ITS 16 artifact_paths. This archive REMOVED it from that declaration rather than binding it.
PD-A1.why_it_cannot_be_bound: A CONTENT_FIRST ARCHIVE BINDS EVERY DECLARED PATH BY ITS sha256 AND tools/research_dispatch.py VERIFIES THOSE DIGESTS AGAINST THE BYTES AT HEAD (_verify_content_only), while the same tool requires a COMPLETED archive's path_sha256 to cover EXACTLY the union of its own and its sources' artifact_paths. The archive's commit_sha and path_sha256 are themselves stored IN dispatch_queue.json. So binding the queue would require the queue to contain its own sha256 -- a hash fixed point, which is not a bookkeeping inconvenience but a preimage problem. There is no ordering of writes that satisfies it.
PD-A1.evidence_this_is_the_repository_conventi: MEASURED, NOT ASSERTED: across every completed content_first archive in this repository -- 59 of them, spanning GOAL-ECDLP-001, GOAL-MD5-001, GOAL-ENDO-001, GOAL-QALG-001, GOAL-SQISIGN-001, GOAL-HQC-001, GOAL-ECQ-002, GOAL-AES-002, GOAL-DREG-001 and the GOAL-SCURVE family -- NOT ONE has its dispatch_queue.json in the archive's path_sha256. Every other batch avoided the problem by never declaring the queue as an artifact. BATCH-145531's opening declared it, which made its own snapshot archive unsatisfiable as written.
PD-A1.what_was_changed_and_what_was_not: ONLY the artifact_paths LIST of a coordination record (the dispatch queue) was changed. NO ledger record, NO immutable evidence, NO run artifact, NO experiment contract and NO committed byte of the producer's package was touched. The queue is explicitly a coordination record and not evidence (docs/dynamic-subagent-dispatch.md). The queue file itself is still committed and still reviewable; what changed is that this archive does not claim a cryptographic binding over it.
PD-A1.who_decided: The driving Coordinator session, at archive time, on the mechanical ground above. IT IS RECORDED HERE RATHER THAN ABSORBED because AGENTS.md requires departures from plan to go in procedure_deviations rather than be quietly resolved, and because a reviewer counting the opening's 16 declared paths against this receipt's 34 would otherwise find an unexplained discrepancy.
PD-A1.what_a_reviewer_should_do_with_it: R3-J1 owns reproduction and frozen identity and may rule on whether this was the right call. The alternative -- leaving the archive permanently unable to complete, and therefore the round unable to start -- is stated here so the choice is visible rather than implied.
